name: OpenVibe.Domains

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else

resumes.what: nothing to rebuild: v1 reads prices from OpenVibe.Host and history from OpenVibe.Tools on demand; a restart only empties the minutes-long in-memory cache, refilled on the next request

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: v1 has no database and no migrations

leases.none: no claims: one process serves the site

notes: Port 5070, unit openvibe-domains.service. The Domains room (plan 2026-10-28 §5.1): one box prices a name across every ending and registrar with 1-, 3- and 5-year totals and the renewal trap flagged; a page per ending with its price history; a page per domain with its public history. v1 is a stateless front over OpenVibe.Host's price catalog (catalog_tld_prices, fed by Sources) and OpenVibe.Tools' domain history; v2 adds the control panel (registrar connections as Network project secrets, the portfolio and change proposals), which is the domains.* authority.

site.name: Domains
site.tagline: Name it, price it, run it
site.what: Every ending and every registrar for a name, with what you will really pay over 1, 3 and 5 years, the renewal traps flagged, and each domain's public history.
